title: Apportioning the Price of a Vacation Package Across the Travelling Party
content:
A package sold under Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products is priced for the party as a whole and then apportioned traveller by traveller, so every per-person amount is read against the party actually travelling and never against the party first quoted.

## The basis of apportionment

A traveller occupying a room or cabin alone carries the product's single supplement, a third adult sharing takes its third-adult discount, and a child within the product's child age takes its child discount; the supplement and the discounts never apply to the same traveller at once. An infant under the product's infant age travels at the flat infant price and is not counted for occupancy, for discounts or for group ratios.

A group at or above the product's free-place ratio earns one free place for every full ratio of paying travellers, and the free place is always the lowest priced place in the party.

Where the party shrinks after booking the remaining travellers are re-priced at the occupancy they are left with, and the re-pricing is charged as an amendment rather than absorbed.

## The loyalty concession the desk may offer

A traveller who has booked more than 3 packages in the last thirty-six months is offered the loyalty concession within the desk's authority and no other. The count is taken over a rolling thirty-six months ending on the handling date, counted back day by day from that date, and it counts the balance payments taken across the traveller's completed packages.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Circumstance of the traveller | Judgement | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Alone in a room or cabin | occupancy carries a supplement | the product's single supplement is added on the per-person price |
| A third adult sharing a room or cabin | occupancy carries a discount | the product's third-adult discount comes off the per-person price |
| Within the product's child age, sharing | age carries a discount | the product's child discount comes off the per-person price |
| Under the product's infant age | not an occupant for pricing | the flat infant price, and no part in occupancy, discounts or group ratios |

A traveller falls under one of the first three rows and never under two of them at once.
